annotation.title_clean: 国务院办公厅关于印发《国家地震应急预案》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the General Office of the State Council on Issuing the National Earthquake Emergency Response Plan
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院办公厅 (General Office of the State Council of China)
annotation.summary_en: China's revised National Earthquake Emergency Response Plan, issued by the State Council General Office in October 2025, replacing the 2012 plan. It sets four-tier disaster classification, command structures, monitoring and reporting, tiered emergency responses, recovery and support measures. Passing mentions of drones, AI and unmanned rescue equipment only.
key_provisions_or_claims: Earthquake disasters classified into four levels (extremely serious, serious, large, general) by deaths and losses
Four-level national emergency response triggered by disaster level or magnitude thresholds
State Council Earthquake Relief Headquarters, office at Ministry of Emergency Management, leads national response
Long-endurance drones and unmanned rescue equipment used when communications and roads are cut
Replaces the 2012 National Earthquake Emergency Plan (国办函〔2012〕149号)
